data.title: ‘Bitcoin Senator’ Lummis Urges Immediate Action on Clarity Act, offering Democrats over 120 of their demands, ahead of pivotal Senate vote tomorrow.
data.description: The Wyoming Republican reported that the final text includes over 120 demands from Democrats, such as extensive new ethics regulations. The Senate will have a crucial cloture vote on Tuesday afternoon.

data.title: SANY Heavy Truck Debuts Production-Ready Electric Truck Portfolio at IAA Transportation 2026
data.description: SANY Heavy Truck, in partnership with Putzmeister, a subsidiary of SANY Group, showcased its presence at the IAA Transportation 2026 event held in HANNOVER, Germany on September 15, 2026. The event highlighted SE636, a key product in SANY's portfolio, with customers having the opportunity to participate in test drives. As part of its strategic approach towards the European market, SANY emphasized its long-term commitment by promoting an established service network designed to cater to the needs of customers in the region. This event not only marked the debut of SANY Heavy Truck at IAA Transportation 2026 but also served as a platform to demonstrate the company's dedication to Europe.

data.title: Faye Unveils New Integration Connecting Intercom and NetSuite, Giving Support Teams Instant Access to Financial Data
data.description: A recent integration now allows for seamless synchronization of contact, company, and financial data between two platforms, enabling customer-facing teams to access information without exiting Intercom. This development was announced in CALABASAS, Calif., on September 15, 2026. Faye, a prominent player in software strategy and AI deployment, spearheaded this initiative to enhance operational efficiency.

data.title: PRRS Responds to MPS Statements at the 2026 National Parking Association Conference & Expo
data.description: Las Vegas, on September 15, 2026 - The current announcement aims to provide clarification on MPS's recent declarations, particularly those communicated to Parking Revenue Recovery Services, Inc. ("PRRS") clients and attendees at the 2026 NPA Conference and Expo. Updates on the patent claims made in June will be discussed.

data.title: TMEIC Opens New Power Electronics Flagship Manufacturing Facility in Waller County, Texas
data.description: In Waller County, Texas, on September 15, 2026, TMEIC Corporation Americas unveiled its latest manufacturing plant, Twinwood, covering an area of 280,000 square feet. This facility marks the third in the United States for the company and is a subsidiary of TMEIC Corporation in Japan.

data.title: Rizing Tide Named Philanthropic Partner for Second Edition of "Called to Care"
data.description: Dr. Larry Benz has announced that he will be contributing all proceeds from his latest book to aid in funding scholarships for upcoming physical therapists from marginalized communities. This decision was revealed in Phoenix on September 15, 2026, and will benefit Rizing Tide, an organization focused on increasing opportunities in physical therapy. The initiative aims to support individuals who face obstacles due to underrepresentation in the field.

data.title: Binance now offers wealth management with 11 US-listed ETFs, focusing on US Treasurys and bonds.
data.description: The cryptocurrency exchange platform is broadening its range of conventional financial services by introducing 11 exchange-traded funds listed in the US. These funds will primarily focus on US Treasurys and high-quality bonds.

data.title: New guide by Anthropic explains deploying Claude AI in sales teams, with 7x ROI case study and three-phase rollout plan.
data.description: Anthropic has released a comprehensive manual detailing the process of implementing Claude AI throughout sales teams. The guide includes a detailed case study showcasing a remarkable Return on Investment (ROI) of 7 times the initial investment. Additionally, it features a structured three-phase strategy for the rollout of the AI system. This resource provides valuable insights for organizations looking to leverage AI in their sales operations effectively.

data.title: MicroTech Named 2026 Corporation of the Year by USHCC
data.description: MicroTech, a prominent Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) and technology solutions provider based in Fort Worth, Texas, has recently been crowned the Corporation of the Year for 2026 by the United States Hispanic Chamber of Commerce (USHCC). This prestigious accolade highlights MicroTech's remarkable record of delivering cutting-edge technology solutions over the span of 22 years. The company has been lauded for its support in crucial customer missions, creation of significant economic opportunities, and showcasing the entrepreneurial spirit of America. The recognition underscores the exceptional dedication and impact MicroTech has made in the industry.

data.description: In London and Dover, Delaware, Lokalise, the AI-focused localization platform, has unveiled Vantage, a cutting-edge workspace for marketing and long-form content creation that does not require coding.
